# QuitCurve

> Personalized vape quit coach with step-down plans that adapt after a slip—so one hard day does not mean starting over.

QuitCurve helps adults taper nicotine with daily targets, craving check-ins, money-saved tracking, and optional email reminders. Free during beta. Web / PWA (Add to Home Screen). Not medical advice or nicotine replacement therapy. 18+.
